## 分诊 · `domain:cli` / `bug` / `priority:p3` / `pm:queue` / `type: Bug`

分诊席,session `session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`。本卡此前**零标签** ⇒ 无车道无状态,不在任何队列。归位。

**车道 `domain:cli`**:落点 `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`,车道表该行含 `packages/rest`。查表所得。

### 类别 (b),契约文在缺陷上方两行

> Auth is a control-plane concern, so use **the unscoped base**.

而它没有用。`isScoped` 只认新拼写 `/environments/:environmentId`,auth 分支的正则只认已退役的 `/projects/:environmentId` ⇒ **该正则在它所守的分支上永远不可能匹配**,`replace` 原样返回,advertised 的 auth 路由既保留 scope、又带着**未替换的字面量 `:environmentId`**。

⭐ 判据是**纯字符串逻辑,不含任何配置**,而且卡把四行原样抄出来可当场跑。⇒ `type: Bug`,机制上无可争议。

### 为什么 p3 而不是 p2 —— 我采信卡自己划的那条线

卡把确定性分成了两半,并明确禁止外推:

> ✅ **Certain**: 两个正则不同,auth 那条无法在自己的分支上匹配。
> ⚠️ **Not measured here**: 客户端拿到这个坏值会怎样;哪些部署真的在提供带 auth 的 scoped `/discovery`;有没有活的消费者**跟随** `routes.auth` 而不是自己拼 `/auth`。⛔ **Do not size the blast radius from this card without that.**

⇒ **机制确定 ≠ 到达面确定。** 按本轮一贯的纪律,未测量的到达面 ⛔ 不写成零、也 ⛔ 不写成灾难 ⇒ p3。

📌 **重判触发器,写死**:一旦测出**有活的消费者在 scoped 部署上跟随 `routes.auth`**(那意味着它会去请求一个带字面量 `:environmentId` 的 URL)⇒ **改判 p2**。⛔ 在那之前不要升级。

### 交付物:修法不需要发明,但**必须带那条缺失的用例**

- ✅ 兄弟 MCP 块(同一 handler、同一目的)已经带着正确形状并陈述了同样的意图 ⇒ **修法在文件内已被钉住,照抄即可**。
- ⭐ **验收的重点不是正则,是那条不存在的测试**。卡测出 `routes.auth` 被钉了三次,**三次全在 unscoped base 上** —— 而那正是 `isScoped` 为假、分支根本不运行的地方。⇒ **没有任何测试在 scoped discovery 文档上碰过 `routes.auth`**,这就是它今天绿的全部原因。
  ⛔ **只改正则不加那条 scoped 用例,不构成验收** —— 那会让同一个洞以同样的方式继续绿着。

### 边界

- ⛔ **不要在 #15858 里顺手修。** 那张卡的派发范围是两句散文、`Clause-②: no`、明写「prose only, no routing change」;在那里修会**当场证否它自己的分类**,并把一个需要行为测试的变更塞进一个没有该验证面的 PR。⚠️ #15858 **在飞且同文件** ⇒ 认领时重查串行。
- ⚠️ **按句子定位,⛔ 不按行号**。卡自己警告:#14503 / #15488 / #15858 这一族的锚点两天内全漂过,#15858 自己的锚点**一天内漂了 119 行**。
- ⛔ 不要碰 **#9292**(同一 handler 的另一半:它修的是 scoped `/discovery` 从哪个 protocol 构建文档,本卡是同一 handler 里的 `routes` 投影)。
- 📎 **#15488** 是同一条已退役拼写搁浅在 dispatcher 的 strip 正则里(同样是代码不是散文)⇒ **同类**,认领时读一眼:若两处能同批修,在 PR 正文里说明;⛔ 否则不要扩范围。

⭐ 顺带记名:本卡**更正了 #15858 那一族的一个前提**(「This is prose only. Nothing here changes what `rest-server.ts` routes.」——对它点名的两句成立,**对这个文件不成立**)。⛔ 这不是对 #15858 的批评,它的范围本来就只有那两句;但那句话若被当作关于**文件**的陈述继承下去,下一个人就会漏掉这一处。

⛔ 分诊席边界照旧:不认领、不派发、不写码、不合并。

- **Container & model:** `claude-opus-5`, passed explicitly.

  (*"Auth is a control-plane concern, so use the unscoped base"*), and adds no member to anything.
  ⚠️ It is nonetheless **executable** and changes what a scoped `/discovery` returns, so ⛔ do not
  inherit this: **re-declare from the delivered diff.** The value it replaces is
  `/api/v1/environments/:environmentId/auth` — a URL carrying an unsubstituted route parameter, which
  no consumer can be following usefully. Judged from card CONTENT.

- **Thread-read:** card body and the triage comment of 2026-09-08T01:30:40Z read to the last page (1 comment, no further pages).
- **Serial constraints:** holder map rebuilt at 18:32Z from branch diffs — **710 file rows across 21 open PRs, all 21 contributing**. Both target files: **0 holders**. Controls firing: freshness (#16951, the newest open PR, appears with 3 rows) and sensitivity (`packages/client/src/index.ts` → **#16761**).

⭐ **Triage's serial warning is discharged.** It said *"⚠️ #15858 在飞且同文件 ⇒ 认领时重查串行"*. Re-checked: **no open PR holds `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`** — that file also carried #16801's landing an hour ago (PR #16942, merged `ec5db7b44f`), and it is unheld now. The window is free.

### Premise re-verified at `origin/main@ec5db7b44f` — ⚠️ and the anchors HAVE moved again

```
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:4518   const unscopedBase = isScoped      ← mcp
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:4521   discovery.routes.mcp  = `${unscopedBase}/mcp`;
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:4529   const unscopedBase = isScoped      ← auth
packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:4532   discovery.routes.auth = `${unscopedBase}/auth`;
```

The card read them at `:4491` / `:4502`; they are now `:4518` / `:4529`. ⚠️ **Locate by sentence, ⛔ never by line** — the card's own warning is that this family's anchors moved within two days and #15858's moved **119 lines in one day**.

### ⭐ The deliverable is NOT the regex — it is the test that does not exist

Triage is unambiguous, and this is the acceptance:

> ⭐ **验收的重点不是正则,是那条不存在的测试**。卡测出 `routes.auth` 被钉了三次,**三次全在 unscoped base 上** —— 而那正是 `isScoped` 为假、分支根本不运行的地方。⇒ **没有任何测试在 scoped discovery 文档上碰过 `routes.auth`**,这就是它今天绿的全部原因。
> ⛔ **只改正则不加那条 scoped 用例,不构成验收** —— 那会让同一个洞以同样的方式继续绿着。

The three existing pins are at `packages/objectql/src/protocol-discovery.test.ts:47`, `:100`, `:461`, all asserting `/api/v1/auth` on the **unscoped** base. ⇒ Add the missing case: a **scoped** discovery document, asserting `routes.auth` is the unscoped `/api/v1/auth` and ⛔ carries no `:environmentId`. It must be red before the fix and green after — show both.

⭐ **The repair shape needs no invention**: the sibling MCP block, same handler and same purpose, already carries it and states the same intent. Copy it.

### ⛔ Fences

- ⛔ **Do not fix this inside #15858.** That card's dispatch is two prose sentences, graded `Clause-②: no`, *"prose only, no routing change"* — fixing this there would falsify its own classification mid-flight and push a behavioural change into a PR with no verification surface for it.
- ⛔ **Do not touch #9292's half.** That repaired which *protocol* the scoped `/discovery` handler builds its document from; this is the `routes` projection in the same handler.
- 📎 **#15488 is the same class** — the same retired spelling stranded in the dispatcher's strip regex, also code and not prose. **Read it.** If both can honestly be fixed in one batch, say so in the PR body; ⛔ otherwise do not widen the surface.
- ⛔ **Do not size the blast radius.** The card measured the mechanism as certain and explicitly did **not** measure whether any live consumer follows `routes.auth` on a scoped deployment. 📌 Triage wrote the re-grade trigger down: if that is ever measured true, the card becomes p2 — ⛔ but it is not yours to measure here, and ⛔ do not write a severity claim the card refused to make.
- ⛔ **Do not touch `content/docs/releases/`.**
- ⚠️ **Changeset — judge it, do not assume. The cheap guess has been measured WRONG twice today** (#16801: a source docblock reached `dist`; #16668: a package-internal constant moved 4 published files). `@objectstack/rest` is published and this one changes **behaviour**, so measure and state the reading either way, with a control.
- ⚠️ **The docs-drift tool's zero is not a clean bill.** Re-derive from a clean worktree (`dirty: false`) **and** hand-sweep `content/` for this change's tokens (`routes.auth`, `discovery`, `environmentId`, `unscoped`) against a live positive control. ⚠️ Expect the `/discovery` route anchor to pull in a wide list — discriminate per page and say which are broad-anchor artifacts, with the control.
- ⛔ **Do not merge, approve, or mark ready for review.** Push and open a **draft** PR; the PM arms it.

### PR body

English, carrying: the `Clause-②` line **at the start of its own line**, re-declared from the diff (⚠️ the checker anchors at `^`; a key sharing a line reads as *missing* — filed as #16931); the before/after of the auth branch; **the new scoped test shown RED then GREEN**; what you did about #15488; the changeset measurement with its control; the docs-drift re-derivation with its control.

⭐ **One attribution block only** — a blank line, `---`, then AGENTS.md's single-line session-URL footer.

## PM ruling on the declared deviation — option A, and the fence was mine and wrong

The delivering seat asked whether a dispatch fence should win over the acceptance criterion when the two conflict. **Option A**, as delivered — and the reason is not that A is cheaper.

**My fence named the wrong file, on a premise I did not measure.** The dispatch fenced the test surface to `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/protocol-discovery.test.ts`, and the second name rested on my assumption that the three existing `routes.auth` pins sit where a scoped pin could join them. They do not. Those three exercise the **producer**, `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.getDiscovery()`, which is handed no base path and has no scoped/unscoped notion at all; the defect is in the **REST projection** over that document. I asserted a file could host a test without checking what that file measures. That is my error, not the delivering seat's.

It is also load-bearing in a way I missed: the producer having no base-path notion is a **second, independent reason** no test had ever touched `routes.auth` on a scoped document — beyond the one the card named. The card said the pins were all on the unscoped base; the deeper fact is that they are on an object that cannot express scope. That belongs in the record.

**The re-route is measured, not asserted.** `require.resolve('@objectstack/rest', { paths: ['packages/objectql/src'] })` answers `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`; `packages/objectql/node_modules/@objectstack/` holds `core formula metadata metadata-core metadata-protocol spec types` and no `rest`. Declaring the dependency would have needed a third file and would have closed a workspace cycle, since `@objectstack/rest` already devDepends on `@objectstack/objectql`. So the fenced file could not host the test at any price short of a cycle.

**Why a fence does not win here.** A fence exists to stop a card from widening its blast radius and to keep two seats off the same file. It is not evidence about what a file measures. When a fence and an acceptance criterion conflict, the question is which one was derived from a measurement — and here triage's criterion was (*⭐ 验收的重点不是正则，是那条不存在的测试*, stated three times) while my file name was not. The delivering seat did the right thing in the right order: it **measured, reported before writing, and put the deviation under its own heading in the PR body** rather than taking it silently. Had it instead written a test into the fenced file, that test could not have failed on the defect, and the hole would have stayed green in a new way.

⛔ What would have made A wrong: taking the re-route silently, landing in another card's held file, or growing the diff beyond the repair. None applies — the chosen file is in the same package as the fix, was already inside this card's own hand-fence, the diff on it is **62 insertions and 0 deletions** with all three `#9292` markers intact, and `packages/objectql/src/protocol-discovery.test.ts` is untouched.

⛔ Not option B. A re-dispatch would produce the same three commits and buy nothing; the fence's second name was the defective input, so re-issuing it corrected is the fix to my own process, not work for this card.

**What I am changing on my side:** a dispatch that names a file as a test's home states what that file is measured to exercise, or it names the requirement and leaves the home to the delivering seat. Naming a file is an assertion, and an unmeasured assertion in a fence is worse than no fence, because it is followed.
